about: American English: only the words an American kitchen says differently from copy/en.json, which is Australian (DECISIONS.md 55). A key missing here is copy/en.json's. Each entry's base is the English it was written against: test/copy.test.ts fails when copy/en.json moves and this does not, so a wording draft that changes one of these keys rewrites it here too. Design: LANGUAGE.md section 2.

action.hint.cold.base: eggs in the pan, lid on, then press Start heating
action.hint.cold.text: eggs in the pot, lid on, then press Start heating

controls.start.more.base: Boiling water: lower the eggs into water that’s boiling hard. They peel more easily this way. Cold water: put the eggs in a cold pan, turn the heat on, and press Full rolling boil when the water rolls. This is quicker overall. Sous-vide: I’ll tell you how long the eggs need in the water.

controls.water.more.base: How much water is in the pan, not counting the eggs. Mostly matters if you turn off the heat after boiling, and a little bit to estimate boiling time.
controls.water.more.text: How much water is in the pot, not counting the eggs. Mostly matters if you turn off the heat after boiling, and a little bit to estimate boiling time.

help.unsure.heatOff.base: With the heat off, I assume an ordinary pan with its lid on. A heavy pot or a loose lid will change the time.
help.unsure.heatOff.text: With the heat off, I assume an ordinary saucepan with its lid on. A heavy pot or a loose lid will change the time.
